title.zh: 【俄罗斯三名高官加入跨境支付公司 A7 董事会】
title.en: 【俄罗斯三名高官加入跨境支付公司 A7 董事会】

current_state.zh: Russia's finance minister, energy minister and first deputy prime minister have joined the board of A7, the PSB-founded firm behind the ruble stablecoin A7A5 that the US sanctioned on October 1 over alleged sanctions-evasion payment networks.
current_state.en: Russia's finance minister, energy minister and first deputy prime minister have joined the board of A7, the PSB-founded firm behind the ruble stablecoin A7A5 that the US sanctioned on October 1 over alleged sanctions-evasion payment networks.
